text:
Hello Kitty Party Land – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Hello Kitty Party Land releases on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch on October 29, 2026! Pre-order today and receive a customizable in-game Avatar T-shirt: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/hello-kitty-party-land-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

This party's just getting started! Meet and play with over 145 beloved Sanrio characters in a variety of mini games. Play solo or with up to three friends, online or offline! 

#HelloKittyPartyLand
